reviews.text: Very happy with the care my cat Historia received; the staff are very kind. I highly recommend them.

Hello, I've been a client for 45 years. Dr. Pouget treated my first cat for 19 years, then my second for 17 years. After that, it was Dr. Hervet until his retirement for my cat Newton and my other cat Liloo. On Saturday, March 1st, I brought my two cats in for a few questions and met Dr. Florent Coindre, whom I found very good with both patients and owners. Even before the consultation, he reviewed the files, is gentle with animals, and a very good listener.

Following a visit, a problem was detected with my cat. He was given treatment, but he had a reaction to it. His condition deteriorated very quickly. Despite my repeated calls to get an emergency appointment (the earliest available was in four days), it was very difficult to communicate and get answers, other than being told it was normal, even though when I took him to another veterinarian, his life was in danger. It's a real shame; I had been going to this clinic for years.

We just got back from an appointment, and the welcome was incredible, so kind and caring. Our little cat, Bernadette, didn't like the injection at all, but we loved the support, the staff's kindness, and how helpfully they explained everything to us. I highly recommend a visit there.
Our cat only gives one star, but we're giving five, wishing we could give more!
Thank you again!

A categorical refusal, or perhaps a blatant refusal, to treat my 15-year-old dog in an emergency. Absolutely no professionalism or empathy for the distress of an elderly animal. Even worse, they had the audacity to refer me to the Seventys clinic in the 12th arrondissement, the very same establishment where my previous dog died due to their incompetence. This is unacceptable and sickening. Avoid this place, which is sorely lacking in humanity (the Seventys group is a money-making machine). I will never forget the harm done to my little Siki, where you sent me to the 12th arrondissement, where I had to pay 3000 euros. What a disgrace.

Doctors Bigeard and Cointre are extremely professional and very good at explaining things (to my cats).

However, like any clinic, it all depends on who you get. I unfortunately had the misfortune of seeing one of their "more experienced" colleagues, who was incredibly arrogant and anesthetized my 14-year-old sick cat, who has always been perfectly calm. His entire medical file can attest to this. No time, no desire, anesthesia.

But the rest of the clinic is excellent 👌
